name: Isekai Harem Quest ~Saikyou no Chikara to Koi no Bouken~
original_name: 異世界ハーレムクエスト ～最強の力と恋の冒険～
source:
Reincarnated as the strongest man in another world, you share a mansion with three women: knight Alize, maid Giselle, and mysterious Mio. Despite your power, they're cold to you. Through dialogue choices, win their hearts in this romance adventure. Can you turn their icy attitudes into a warm harem?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3516700/]Steam[/url]]
